title: Chapter 959
paragraphs: Chapter 959
Episode 236th. Fire of Destruction, Cruel Past (2)
"It's been a long time, Kelliark Zipfel. However, it's not very pleasant. I would not have done so if I had met you as a corpse, as planned."
Jin responded, scanning the battlefield.
Spirit energy and flame, two energies divided the sky of Dokmaseong. Only there was much more flame occupying a larger area, because Murakan was not present in this location.
'...Murakan seems to have fallen out of the fight with Kelliark. Reading the energy closely, I feel Murakan's spirit energy from the outskirts of the battlefield.'
The remaining spirit energy in the sky was a trace of the dark arrival. As Jin predicted, Murakan was defending Veradin, tied Kelliark to find Betty, and had temporarily left the battlefield.
'Then Murakan will be back soon. He probably read my energy by now too.'
Even though he's somewhat tired, along with Jin, there's Elona Zipfel, and Murakan will be back soon.
Even though it's not whole, there are three champion-class forces. No matter how great Kelliark's power became by merging with Sheenu, it would be impossible to face all three of them.
'Of course, that's if Kelliark fights properly...'
Kelliark was looking down at Jin and Elona with a calm face. Jin was certain that he wouldn't have welcomed them without any preparation.
The remnants of Zito and the artificial sun blowing from all sides were gathering towards Kelliark.
However, Kelliark was collecting these powers in a spherical form above his head, not directly attributing them to himself.
Because it was pointless to gain more power. Since he already had the power of the highest god, absorbing the remnants of Zito and the artificial sun would only increase the impurities in his body.
Kelliark intended to use the power of Zito and the artificial sun elsewhere. And Jin, feeling he might know that intention, was raising his energy.
"As planned... It's interesting to hear such words from you."
"What's so amusing?"
"44 years."
It's an out-of-the-blue answer that others couldn't understand. However, Jin couldn't help but be surprised as soon as Kelliark mentioned the word '44 years'.
-It took a whopping 44 years to find out... that Joshua had paid Tyumen Marius to curse you.
-Jebal, Kaak. It's, don....

-"I didn't even have the chance to plead like you are now. Keydart, back then, I was only one year old. Your pathetic 80 years can never compensate for my 44 years, but you may as well make good use of the book of regression."
The words spoken while killing Keydart Hol.
Jin didn't react and just stared at Kelliark.

"After hearing about you from Keydart, I was always curious. Why did you say 44 years... The conclusion I eventually reached was this. You must be a person who has experienced the future once, right?"

"Hell. After becoming aware of the existence of the netherworld, I did have that thought. There must be the villains I've killed over time there. Keydart Hol, you seem to have got that vile insect in your hand and resurrected him like Anne Runcandel."
"Answer my question. I'm very curious."
"It doesn't seem to me to matter what Keydart babbled. But to answer your question, I think I might have misheard due to dull senses before dying."

"Is that so... anyway, from what I see, there is no being more deviant than you in this world. You have made a pact with Solderet and use his power, but Solderet does not exist in this world. This fact alone makes you a monster."
"Do you know that Solderet does not exist in this world by gaining Sheenu's senses?"

"It's true, but it's not just because of that. We, Zipples, pursued Solderet for a long time to complete the Demon Stone. But since you became the contractor, Solderet has never once revealed his true form. Perhaps, like me, he became one with you. Or maybe he paid something for you."
"Think what you will. But Kelliark, you seem to be in quite an annoying situation now. You seemed to want to lure and kill Veradin, but you failed because my guardian dragon intervened, didn't you?"
Jin said, examining Elona's expression.
Elona looked much more comfortable than before. She felt the energy of Veradin, who was far away, through her sense of Genesis. Just as Jin had guaranteed, Veradin was indeed alive.
"It's strange. I sent Murakan to find the Viseps over there, but he accidentally saved Veradin, and the Viseps are now here. It's like the world is helping me."
The world seems to be helping me.
Words that Jin said without much thought scratched at Kelliark's insides. The 'power of existence' that Jin possessed was even more repulsive than the power of Genesis.
"I'll tell you what's going to happen now, Kelliark. You're probably planning to use the power of Zito and the artificial sun to completely destroy the underworld."

"Ho. I must acknowledge that extraordinary brain of yours. Yes, you have just become the new owner of this land, thanks to your blocking Zito. But I no longer need this place, and the witch doesn't seem to be particularly interested either... so it's better to destroy it. It might even be a better ending for the demons who were brainwashed by Zito and committed disgusting deeds."
Jin let out a seemingly amused chuckle.

"Right now, you don't have the confidence to fight us, so your best choice is to try to buy time by destroying the entire hell realm. No one in the world could blame you even if they laughed at you. Moreover, your plan will fail again, Kelliark Zephyr."
As Jin drew his Sigmund, a golden aura began to spread. The aura left by Murakan also resonated with it, turning gold.

"That's because I won't allow it. Do you really feel like a god after gaining the power of Shino, Kelliark? Try blowing up the remnants of Zito and the artificial sun. We will prevent the explosion, and even take your life."
Elona also raised her staff and amplified her magic. Large magical cubes were floating all over the battlefield.
"Kelliark Zephyr, as a top magician of Zephyr from a thousand years ago and as a current elder of Zephyr, I will sternly punish you for daring to harm the head family."
As Elona finished her words, the sky behind the two darkened.
It was the aura spreading from Murakan's pair of wings.
[Little one! Oh, is that Elona Zephyr beside you? What's this, have you joined our side?]
Although Murakan had also been protecting allies and fighting Kelliark the whole time, depleting a lot of his strength, his authority was still undamaged.
"That's right. You've joined our side. You've arrived, Murakan."

[Oh, I'll hear about what happened later. The kids are all safe. I think there's a guy named Regal or something annoying left, but it's fine because Immortal Flame is there. When the golden aura briefly spread throughout Hell, I was certain you handled Zito well without me. It looks like Elona helped too.]
"It's been a while, Murakan. There's a lot I want to talk about with you."
[Yeah, yeah. I also have a lot of questions, Elona. But first, we need to handle Kelliark.]
Murakan also quickly understood the situation. That is, Kelliark will use the remnants of Zito and the artificial sun to buy time to escape.

'Hmm. If those things all explode at once, it will be tough. But if Elona and I prevent the explosion from spreading outside Hell, and the little one gets inside and grabs Kelliark. That would be a rough plan.'

Jin and Elona had the same thought. Even though Jin was the most exhausted, he was still the strongest in close combat among the three, and Murakan and Elona were much better suited to handle a large-scale explosion.
"Such a confident appearance that I almost feel sorry to crush..."
Kelliark said.
Jin and his party couldn't move first. They had to wait until he detonated the remnants of Zito and the artificial sun so that their positions wouldn't be disrupted.
Soon after, Kelliark and Elona locked eyes.

"Elona Zipfel. The most powerful and greatest magician in the history of Zipfel, known to have been the best magician a thousand years ago, and now serving as the elder, yet decided to side with Runcandel... It seems that our lost ancestor has many faces."
"Let's just say I've come to realize the truth."
"Truth? I'm hearing another interesting word. What truth have you realized?"
"That I am not just a Zipfel, or a person who exists for the destruction to be carried out by Zipfel."
"Then there should be no reason for you to come to Hell to save my son now. Veradin is the current head of Zipfel, so it seems that you have come to find me for Zipfel."
"The head, no. Veradin is the person I love. Even if he is no longer the head in the future, even if he abandons Zipfel, I will always sacrifice my life for the head. You wouldn't understand."
"Human, Lady Elona. You talk as if you are a human. Then let me ask you one more thing. Do you remember who your parents are?"
Elona's pupils dilated.
"As expected, you don't remember. Then where were you raised? What is your first memory after gaining self-awareness? Or even, do you remember what your original form was?"
Nothing came to mind.
It was a completely unexpected question. As if part of her consciousness was blocked, Elona had never once remembered such things in her life.
The magical cubes that Elona had created were vibrating unstably. It meant her inner self was shaking.
[Elona, don't worry about his nonsense. Our historian can tell you all you want to know.]
"But you brag about having realized the truth without knowing that, it's really pitiful for me. Lady Elona, I will now tell you the real truth."
As Kelliark finished his words, he detonated the remains of the Earth and artificial sun he had gathered in the sky.
Jin immediately took a stance to close the distance with Kelliark, and Murakan spread the Dark Arrival to prevent the explosion from spreading.
However, Elona, who should have moved together, was nailed to her spot. If she falls out, Jin won't be able to get into Kelliark.
[Elona, what are you doing!]
Murakan's voice did not reach Elona.

While the remnants exploded and covered the party in an instant, Elona stared at an object Kelliark pulled out, as if she were mesmerized. A strong irresistible attraction was gnawing at Elona's neck.
"This glowing object, similar to a lunisolar calendar, is your mother. Or, it could be said to be your original form."
